raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "clamped boundary",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 2 delegates the support arrangement to unavailable Fig. 1. The supported edge and its supported fraction are not written. Here L=20 and H=10 follow from the stated initial grid and cell size.",
      "readings": [
        "Clamp the entire left edge: x=0, 0≤y≤H.",
        "Clamp the entire right edge: x=L, 0≤y≤H.",
        "Clamp only the central half of the left edge: x=0, H/4≤y≤3H/4."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "cantilever load",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Neither Sec. 2 nor Fig. 1's caption gives load coordinates. For a left-clamped domain, several free-end positions remain possible.",
      "readings": [
        "Free-end midpoint: (x,y)=(L,H/2).",
        "Lower free-end corner: (x,y)=(L,0).",
        "Upper free-end corner: (x,y)=(L,H)."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "spatial distribution of applied force",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Eq. 1 introduces a boundary traction, but Sec. 2 does not specify whether the benchmark uses a concentrated force, a loaded patch, or an extended traction.",
      "readings": [
        "One concentrated nodal force.",
        "Uniform traction over a free-edge segment of length H/10.",
        "Uniform traction over the entire free edge."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "applied load vector",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The components or angle of the traction vector in Eq. 1 are not supplied in Sec. 2, Table 1, or Fig. 1's caption.",
      "readings": [
        "Vertical downward load: (Fx,Fy)=(0,-F).",
        "Horizontal outward load: (Fx,Fy)=(F,0), for a left clamp.",
        "Oblique load: (Fx,Fy)=(F/√2,-F/√2)."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "overall load amplitude",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. 1 names the prescribed traction, but Sec. 2 and Table 1 provide no numerical traction or resultant-force magnitude.",
      "readings": [
        "Total resultant force F=1 in consistent units.",
        "Total resultant force F=10^-3 in consistent units."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "prescribed material at supports or load application",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No text specifies whether support or loading pads are excluded from optimization, or gives their dimensions and prescribed densities.",
      "readings": [
        "No passive regions; all cells are designable.",
        "Prescribe density 1 in a 0.25-wide strip adjoining the clamp.",
        "Prescribe density 1 in a 0.25×0.25 pad adjoining the load."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "reference volume and passive-material accounting",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Table 1 fixes the fraction at 0.3, but Eq. 1 does not explicitly define V0 or explain accounting if non-design regions exist.",
      "readings": [
        "Apply 0.3 to the full reference-domain volume, counting passive solid material against the budget.",
        "Apply 0.3 only to the designable-region volume, excluding passive material from the budget and normalization."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "density field used in the volume constraint",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Eq. 1 writes volume in terms of rho, while Sec. 2 introduces PDE regularization without rewriting the constraint to distinguish design and filtered densities.",
      "readings": [
        "Constrain the volume of the raw element design densities.",
        "Constrain the volume of the filtered physical densities used for stiffness."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "two-dimensional constitutive model",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Table 1 gives linear elasticity, E=1, and μ=0.3, but does not state the in-plane constitutive reduction.",
      "readings": [
        "Isotropic plane stress with Poisson's ratio 0.3.",
        "Isotropic plane strain with Poisson's ratio 0.3."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "reference out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 interprets density as thickness but does not specify the reference thickness used in finite-element stiffness and volume calculations.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform reference thickness t_ref=1.",
        "Uniform reference thickness t_ref=0.1.",
        "Uniform reference thickness t_ref=10."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Helmholtz filter equation and radius convention",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Table 1 fixes the radius at 0.375, but Sec. 2 supplies no PDE defining how that radius enters the Helmholtz operator.",
      "readings": [
        "Solve filtered_rho - r² Laplacian(filtered_rho) = rho, with r=0.375.",
        "Solve filtered_rho - (r²/12) Laplacian(filtered_rho) = rho, with r=0.375."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "filter boundary treatment",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 names a Helmholtz-type PDE filter but gives no boundary conditions or exterior-padding rule.",
      "readings": [
        "Zero normal derivative on every exterior boundary.",
        "Zero filtered density on every exterior boundary.",
        "Pad the domain with fixed void over a width r and impose zero normal derivative at the padding boundary."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "discrete filter and transfer between density representations",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The PDE filter's approximation space, mass treatment, and transfer between element densities and filter unknowns are not specified.",
      "readings": [
        "Q1 Galerkin filter with a consistent mass matrix, cellwise-constant input, and element-average output.",
        "Q1 filter with nodal averaging, mass lumping, and nodal-to-cell averaging.",
        "Cell-centered finite-volume Helmholtz filter acting directly on cell densities."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "GOCM exponential update and sensitivity normalization",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2 names GOCM and Table 1 specifies an exponential update, but no update equation or sensitivity normalization is provided to define how the stated step length acts.",
      "readings": [
        "Drive the exponential update with unscaled Lagrangian sensitivities.",
        "Normalize compliance sensitivities by the current compliance before the exponential update.",
        "Normalize sensitivities by their maximum absolute magnitude before the exponential update."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "volume-multiplier solution accuracy",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The GOCM description does not specify the numerical accuracy used to enforce the volume constraint during each update.",
      "readings": [
        "Solve the multiplier until the absolute volume-fraction residual is at most 10^-6.",
        "Solve the multiplier until the absolute volume-fraction residual is at most 10^-10."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "meaning of density change in the stopping criterion",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Eq. 2 does not define whether Δrho_e is an absolute or signed change. These interpretations behave differently when the volume constraint is active.",
      "readings": [
        "Use the volume-weighted mean of |rho_e(new)-rho_e(old)|.",
        "Use the absolute value of the volume-weighted mean signed change.",
        "Use the volume-weighted signed change directly, as a literal reading of Eq. 2."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "displacement finite-element approximation",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 gives cell sizes and counts and names deal.II, but does not give the displacement element's polynomial degree.",
      "readings": [
        "Bilinear Q1 quadrilateral displacement elements.",
        "Biquadratic Q2 quadrilateral displacement elements."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "stiffness integration",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No quadrature or reduced-integration treatment is specified for the elasticity assembly.",
      "readings": [
        "Full integration: 2×2 Gauss points for Q1 elements.",
        "Reduced integration: one Gauss point for Q1 elements with hourglass stabilization.",
        "Full integration: 3×3 Gauss points for Q2 elements."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "elasticity and filter linear-system accuracy",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Neither the state-equation nor filter-equation linear solver and residual tolerances are reported.",
      "readings": [
        "Sparse direct solves to numerical precision.",
        "Iterative solves with relative residual tolerance 10^-6.",
        "Iterative solves with relative residual tolerance 10^-10."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "finest cell size",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Sec. 2 prints h4=1×0.5^4=0.06125, but the expression equals 0.0625. Remark 1's 320×160 grid over the inferred 20×10 domain also requires 0.0625.",
      "readings": [
        "Use h4=0.0625, following the refinement formula and 320×160 fixed grid.",
        "Treat the printed h4=0.06125 as the intended spacing, requiring revised grid counts or domain dimensions."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
